# `quote`

<!-- Generated by `vidgen gallery`; edit the sample in AGENTS.md (or video.yaml), not this file. -->

**Use it for:** a quotation.

Beat 1 reveals the quote, beat 2 the attribution (both in beat 1 if there is only one).

## YAML

From the author guide (`vidgen guide scenes`):

```yaml
- id: saying
  type: quote
  params: {text: "Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability.", author: "Edsger W. Dijkstra"}
  beats: [{text: "As Dijkstra put it, simple systems are the reliable ones."}]
```

## Params

| param | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `str` | required | The quote. |
| `author` | `str` |  | Shown as '- author'. |
| `source` | `str` |  | Shown smaller under the author. |
| `size` | `size` | `'subtitle'` | Quote text size (shrunk if long). |
| `color` | `color` | `'text'` | Quote text color. |
| `mark_color` | `color` | `'primary'` | Color of the large quote mark. |
| `mark_font` | `str \| None` |  | Font of the quote mark; default: the theme's font for the `quote_mark` role (font_serif, Source Serif 4). |
| `author_color` | `color` | `'text'` | Author color. |
| `source_color` | `color` | `'dim'` | Source color. |

## Targets

`mark`, `quote`, `author`, `source`

## Beats

Any number.
